optimizedContext.value:
# Workflow Automation

## Rules

### Diagnostic Priority
- Agents SHALL prefer `--format text` for lifecycle status, transition, validation — human-readable blockers/notes.

### Data Extraction
- Machine formats ONLY when structured extraction needed for later tool calls/state.
- MUST prefer `--format toon`. MAY use `--format json` only if `toon` unavailable or explicitly requested.

### On-demand outline retrieval
- When artifact-instruction gives only outline refs (e.g. `availableOutlines`), MUST fetch via:
  `specd specs outline <specPath> --artifact <artifactId>`
- MUST NOT rely on embedded full outline trees in `changes artifact-instruction` output.

### Repair Strategy
- Follow "Next Action" from command outputs before retrying failed lifecycle op.

### Canonical Command References
- Agent workflow instructions/examples MUST use plural groups: `changes`, `specs`, `archives`, `drafts`.
- Singular forms MAY appear as aliases only.
- Outline example canonical: `specd specs outline <specPath> --artifact <artifactId>`.

### Command Necessity and Freshness
- MUST avoid redundant cmds when prior cmd in same skill execution already supplies equivalent fields.
- Skip ONLY if: (1) info already in current-step prior output, AND (2) still fresh for current decision boundary.
- MUST NOT assume continuity across separate skill invocations — re-read minimal state when session/skill may differ.
- Non-deterministic equivalence → run explicit command.

### Structural Validation and Content Review
- `specd changes validate` = structural/state only. Success MUST NOT mean semantic content approval.
- MUST review requirements/constraints/intent before lifecycle steps needing artifact correctness.
- Successful individual validate of delta-backed `scope: spec` artifact: review inline diff from `specd changes validate` for unintended removals/contract breakage.
- If inline diff unavailable (validate failed / non-fatal diff-gen failure path), fall back:
  `specd changes spec-preview <change-name> <specId> --diff --artifact <artifactId>`
- Broader overlap/drift risk: verify merged content via `specd changes spec-preview <change-name> <specId>` before accepting delta.
- Single-artifact review: prefer `specd changes spec-preview <change-name> <specId> --artifact <artifactId>`.

### Implementation traceability policy
- MUST use `specd changes implementation add` for spec-to-file/symbol links.
- Tracked implementation files = review surface distinct from confirmed links.
- MUST resolve or ignore tracked files before archive; multi-file: prefer comma-separated `--file`.
- Use implementation integrity review for stale symbol links / sidecar issues.

### Context optimization policy
- When `llmOptimizedContext` enabled, prefer ultra-terse metadata-compiled context.
- Orchestrators SHOULD delegate to `specd-project-context-optimizer` / `specd-spec-context-optimizer` when subagents supported.
- Else orchestrator MUST optimize inline per smart caveman in `skills:agents`.

## Constraints

- None beyond rules above.
